Granny Gear look — mock-up for approval

Left: today (vendor parity). Right: the proposed Granny Gear look — Home v3 adds a coloured icon badge per menu tile (inline SVG, Lucide-style strokes, no icon font). Training updated per your notes: Speed chip first, lap table shows now + last 3 laps, buttons mid-screen, HR/Power and Cadence/W'bal charts below them (restyled), summary tiles at the bottom using the GG emblem and the Granny Gear Workshop palette. Nothing in the app changes until you say so.
